value.text:
h08.

Two types declare `RunOnce`, both named `Runner` but in different packages, and only one of them is actually called.

- `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43`) — yes, invoked — `(*Server).startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go:163` (synchronous startup call), and also self-invoked from its own ticker loop `(*Runner).Run` at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`
- `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) — no — no caller anywhere (no production or test call sites)

Supporting detail: `memopayload.Runner` is effectively dead code — its constructor `memopayload.NewRunner` has no callers either. The only part of that package used in production is the free function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`, called from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447`, which bypasses the `Runner` type entirely.
